coverage: Fresh full Linux/Python 3.12 requirements resolution; not installed-image or runtime SBOM; OS/base-image packages and deployed versions were not audited.
deduplication: Package plus canonical GHSA; raw duplicate aliases/records retained as counts, not distinct vulnerabilities.

proposed_remediation.reason: Current FastAPI pin requires starlette>=0.40.0,<0.49.0, which excludes every reported Starlette fix. The proposed pair resolves on Linux/Python 3.12 and removes all six reported Starlette advisories.

46.0.7 has four distinct reported advisories. 48.0.1 fixes the wheel advisory, 49.0.0 fixes the two verifier advisories, and 50.0.0 fixes the PKCS7 oracle. Proposed 50.0.2 resolves and re-audits clean; major upgrade needs application approval and regression tests.

No patched ecdsa release is planned. Crypto extra does not remove the mandatory dependency. Assess a documented bounded exception for current non-ECDSA use or a separately reviewed JWT dependency replacement; do not claim this is fixed by pinning or blind suppression.

urgent_parent_review.inference: Malformed Host may bypass the IP rate-limit gate because it uses reconstructed request.url.path. This is a rate-limit gate finding, not proof of login authorization bypass.
urgent_parent_review.suggested_followup: Parent should assess raw ASGI scope path for gating/keying, reject malformed Host upstream or in trusted-host validation, and add a crafted-Host regression test. No parent file edited and no live exploit attempted.

sanitizer: Explicit allowlist of public package/version/advisory metadata and repository-relative source references. No environment values, credentials, request payloads, or deployment logs are included.
